cues: A hand tool turns threaded fasteners into wood, joining trim pieces during small household repairs.
The narrow working end reaches a recessed fastener inside a child’s battery-powered toy.
A homeowner tightens the small fasteners on a loose drawer runner to restore smooth movement.
At a craft table, careful wrist turns attach a wooden handle to a handmade keepsake box.
A repairer removes tiny fasteners from a smoke alarm before replacing its aging battery.
For furniture assembly, turning short threaded fasteners helps join panels without bulky hardware.
